people.bio: Wiki-based biography draft. 蔣中正 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 浙江奉化 in 1887; died in 1975; affiliation 國民革命軍／中央軍; highest recorded post 國民政府軍事委員會委員長／中華民國總統; active period 北伐時期, 抗戰前期, 抗日後期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 蔣中正, 譜名周泰, 學名志清, 字介石, 浙江奉化.in 1908加入中國同盟會, in 1911 participated inXinhai Revolution, in 1913加入中華革命黨. held the posts of 援閩粵軍 commander-in-chief 部 combat operations 科主 served as, 粵軍第二軍 chief of staff, 東路討賊軍第二軍 chief of staff 等職, gradually 取得孫中山信 served as, in 1924 becameWhampoa Military Academypresident of the school, established 起以黃埔系為核心的軍事班底. in 1926 National Revolutionary ArmyNorthern Expedition, 蔣 served ascommander-in-chief. in 1928 Northern Expedition 成功後, 先後 also served aschairman of the Nationalist government, president of the Executive Yuan, Nationalist governmentchairman of the Military Commission, for a long period 為 Nationalist government 實際最高 led 人, the faction he led 被稱為中央軍. in 1936西安事變後轉向聯共抗日; in 1937中國 the War of Resistance against Japan broke out nationwide, 蔣 led 中國軍民 continued 抵抗, in 1942 became 同盟國 China Theater 最高統帥. 戰後 promoted 制憲國民大會, in 1948當選中華民國首 served aspresident, in the same year 因第二次國共內戰失利下野. in 1949中華民國政府遷往臺灣後, 蔣復行視事, continued 統治臺灣直至 in 1975 died of illness. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 何應欽 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 貴州興義 in 1890; died in 1987; affiliation 國民革命軍／中央軍（黃埔系）; highest recorded post 國防部部長／行政院院長; active period 北伐時期, 抗戰前期, 抗日後期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 何應欽, 字敬之, 貴州興義人, 祖籍江西金谿, 畢業於日本 Army 士官學校. Nationalist governmentwas established 後 for a long period 為黃埔系核心人物, 與蔣中正並稱"蔣何". held the posts of 軍政部部長, Nationalist governmentMilitary Commission 北平軍分會委員長, 大本營 chief of the general staff, participated inNorthern Expedition 與多場對日 operational command 協調. 抗戰時期 served asChina Theater 中國 Armycommander-in-chief, in 1945於南京主持接受日本 surrender 的受降儀式, 並 served as 聯合國軍事 staff officer 團中國代表團 regimental commander. 戰後 held the posts of 國防部部長, president of the Executive Yuan. in 1949中華民國政府遷臺後, served aspresident 府戰略顧問委員會主 served as 委員, 並 served asKuomintang 中央評議委員, 國民大會主席團主席, 也 once served as 臺灣觀光協會首 served as 榮譽會長. wrote《八年抗戰》, 《中國與世界前途》, once served as 上海大夏大學董事長. 1987-10-21在臺灣 died. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 馮玉祥 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 安徽廬州巢縣（生長於直隸保定府） in 1882; died in 1948; affiliation 西北軍（國民軍／國民聯軍）; highest recorded post 國民革命軍第二集團軍總司令; active period 北伐時期, 抗戰前期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 馮玉祥, 譜名基善, 字煥章, 安徽廬州巢縣人, 生長於直隸保定府. 早年投身淮軍及北洋新軍, 本屬直系 warlord. in 1924 Second Zhili–Fengtian Warduring this period 發動北京政變, changed sides 推翻曹錕, 吳佩孚, his forceswas reorganized as 國民軍, afterwardsfor a time 與奉系合作又決裂, retreated after defeat 西北自成一系, was known as 西北軍. in 1926 went to 蘇聯考察 returned to China 後, 於綏遠五原誓師, announcedhis forces 效忠 Nationalist government, 加入 Kuomintang, was reorganized asNational United Army, afterwards 編為 National Revolutionary Army 第二集團軍, 馮 served ascommander-in-chief, led his forcesparticipated inNorthern Expedition. in 1930聯合閻錫山, 李宗仁發動 Central Plains War 反蔣, was defeated 後兵權為蔣中正收編. War of Resistance against Japanduring this period 曾短暫 led 察哈爾民眾抗日同盟軍等抗日武力, 但 for a long period 無實際兵權. in 1935獲 served asNational Revolutionary ArmyArmy 一級 general. 戰後 went to 美考察 during this period 轉向支持 Chinese Communist Party, 公開批評 Nationalist government, in 1948響應中共號召啟程 returned 大陸, in the same year 9月1日於途中 died. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 閻錫山 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 山西五臺 in 1883; died in 1960; affiliation 晉系; highest recorded post 行政院院長／太原綏靖公署主任; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 閻錫山, 字百川 (一作伯川), 山西五臺人, 清末舉人出身. in 1911 Xinhai Revolution 爆發, served as 山西新軍標統響應 uprising, 取得山西政權, 自此 for a long period 主政山西, 開創北洋 warlord 中的"晉系". 歷經北洋政府時期, National Revolutionary ArmyNorthern Expedition, Central Plains War, War of Resistance against Japan 及國共內戰, 山西政權 continued 38年, 是民國 warlord 中在位最久者. in 1917起在山西推行"六政三事"等地方建設, 發展農業, 實業與教育. Northern Expeditionduring this periodhis forceswas reorganized asNational Revolutionary Army 第三集團軍, 配合蔣中正 combat operations; in 1930聯合馮玉祥, 李宗仁發動 Central Plains War 反蔣, 失敗後 for a time 下野, afterwards 復出. during the War of Resistanceserved as 第二戰區 commander, commanded 晉綏軍在山西對日 combat operations. 國共內戰後期, 1949-04太原 campaign 後山西政權為 People's Liberation Army 攻陷, 閻錫山 went to 廣州 becamepresident of the Executive Yuan 兼國防部部長, afterwards 隨中華民國政府遷往臺灣, once served aspresident 府資政, 山西大學 president of the school 等職, 1960-05-23 died of illness 於臺灣. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 王柏齡 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 江蘇江都 in 1889; died in 1942; affiliation 國民革命軍／黃埔系; highest recorded post 黃埔軍校教育長（代理）; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 王柏齡, 字茂如, 法名慧常, 江蘇江都人, National Revolutionary ArmyArmygeneral. in 1924 Whampoa Military Academy 創辦時 served as 籌備委員會委員, participated in 建校工作, afterwardsserved asmilitary academy 教授部主 served as, 並 served as 黨軍第二團 regimental commander (第一團 regimental commander 為何應欽). in 1925調 served asmilitary academychief of staff, in the same year 7月代理教育長. 晚年皈依佛教, 為佛教居士, 1942-08-26 died of illness. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 譚曙卿 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 湖南湘潭 in 1884; died in 1938; affiliation 國民革命軍; highest recorded post 國民革命軍新編第一軍軍長; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 譚曙卿, 字鎮湘, 湖南湘潭人, National Revolutionary Army 將領. 早年喪父, 隨母親乞討維生, 後投入福建新軍 Army 第十鎮許崇智部, 隨許崇智加入中國同盟會及 Kuomintang. 曾 participated inNational Revolutionary Army 東征的第二次潮梅 battle, 惠州 campaign, 以及 Northern Expeditionduring this period 的松口 battle, 永定 battle, 戰後升 served as 新編第一軍 lieutenant generalarmy commander 兼第三路軍總 commanded, 收編吳威, 郭鳳鳴, 盧興邦等地方武力. Northern Expedition 結束後轉入 Military Commissionfor a long period 擔 served asstaff officer 職務, in 1938因急性肺炎病死於西北. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 劉驥 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 湖北武昌（祖籍鍾祥） in 1887; died in 1967; affiliation 西北軍（國民軍）; highest recorded post 隴海鐵路督辦; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 劉驥, 字谷生, 號菊村, 祖籍湖北鍾祥, was born in 武昌, 中華民國軍事將領, 馮玉祥重要幕僚之一. Xinhai Revolution 爆發後 took part in 灤州 uprising, afterwardsserved as 湖北都督府 staff officer, 入北京 Army 大學第四期深造. 畢業後 served as 馮玉祥所率 Army 第十六混成旅 majorstaff officer, afterwardsheld the posts of 北京政府臨時參政院參議, 察西鎮守使等職, for a long period 隨馮玉祥 unit 發展. in 1926馮玉祥五原誓師後 his forceswas reorganized asNational Revolutionary Army, 劉驥隨馮 participated inNorthern Expedition. 1928-08, Nationalist government 特派劉驥為隴海鐵路督辦. in 1967 died of illness, 享年81歲. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 劉峙 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 江西吉安 in 1892; died in 1971; affiliation 國民革命軍／中央軍; highest recorded post 徐州剿匪總司令部總司令; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 劉峙, 字經扶, 江西吉安人, 中華民國 National Revolutionary ArmyArmy 二級 general, once served asWhampoa Military Academy 教官, 深得蔣中正信 served as. participated inNorthern Expedition, Central Plains War 等多場戰事, 抗戰時期 served as 第一戰區第二集團軍 commander, 第五戰區 commander. in 1948受蔣中正 served as 命為徐州剿匪 commander-in-chief 部 commander-in-chief, commanded 徐蚌 campaign, 因國防部內有情報洩密及戰局失控, 全軍潰敗. 劉峙 afterwards 被撤職, 改 served aspresident 府戰略顧問, in 1949底經香港轉往印尼. in 1953獲准 went to 臺灣, served aspresident 府國策顧問, 1971-01-05 died of illness. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 馮軼裴 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in unknown; death year unknown; affiliation 國民革命軍; highest recorded post 師長; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 馮軼裴, 保定 Armyofficer 學校 infantry 科畢業, National Revolutionary Army 將領. Northern Expeditionduring this periodonce served as 獨立第二師 division commander, 第十師 division commander, 並率第十四師 participated in 福建方面對閩軍 combat operations. in 1930代 once served as 教導第一師 division commander, in 1931因 participated in 剿共 combat operations 有功獲頒寶鼎勳章. 晚年寓居南京珞珈路, 該處留有其舊居. 維基百科未見其專條, 生平細節僅散見於相關 campaign 與人物條目, the birth and death years are unknown. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 朱培德 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 雲南祿豐 in 1889; died in 1937; affiliation 滇系→國民革命軍; highest recorded post 國民革命軍參謀總長; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 朱培德, 字益之, 雲南祿豐人, National Revolutionary Army 一級 general. 軍旅生涯初期屬滇系 warlord, 後獲孫中山, 蔣中正信 served as, 成功將雲南系 unit 轉入 National Revolutionary Army 體系. held the posts of 廣州警備 commander, National Revolutionary Army 第三軍 army commander, 江西省政府主席, participated inNorthern Expeditioncombat operations. afterwards 升 served aschief of the general staff, 並 served asKuomintang 第五屆中央執行委員, 中央政治委員會委員等職. 1937-02-17因醫療事故去世. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 錢大鈞 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 江蘇吳縣 in 1893; died in 1982; affiliation 國民革命軍／中央軍; highest recorded post 中華民國陸軍二級上將; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 錢大鈞, 字慕尹, 江蘇吳縣人, 中華民國 Army 二級 general, 青天白日勳章獲勳者. National Revolutionary Army 創立時的核心人物之一, once served as 孫中山組織 army 時的 staff officer, 同時也是蔣中正的核心幕僚之一, for a long periodparticipated in 軍事機要與後勤工作. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 蔡仲笏 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in unknown; death year unknown; affiliation unknown affiliation; highest recorded post no confirmed highest post; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 蔡仲笏, birth and birthplace are unknown, no record was found under this spelling. Chinese Wikipedia 記, in 1924底 National Revolutionary Army 以 Whampoa Military Academy 第二期學生為骨幹組建 artillery 營, battalion commander 為蔡忠笏, 陳誠, 羅卓英分 served as 第一, 第三連連長; the Northern Expedition period 的 battle 序列列 National Revolutionary Army 第一軍 artillery 團 regimental commander 為蔡忠笏, 淞滬 campaign 的 artillery 序列亦列其名. another record states thatthe Republic of China government office database, 該蔡忠笏1928-07-25 served asNational Revolutionary ArmyArmy 第三師 infantry 第七旅 brigade commander, 1934-11-18 served asArmyartillery 第二旅 brigade commander, 1936-02-01敘 Armymajor general, 1939-10-14署浙江磐安縣縣長, 1941-06-10免. 保定 Armyofficer 學校第三期 artillery 科名單亦有其名. 名字與遊戲寫法一字之差, 兵科與時期相合, whether this was the same person remains unconfirmed. Wiki-based biography draft. 譚延闓 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 湖南茶陵 in 1880; died in 1930; affiliation 國民政府; highest recorded post 行政院院長（第一任）; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 譚延闓, 幼名寶璐, 字組庵 (或作祖庵, 組安, 祖安), 別號無畏, 齋號切齋, 湖南茶陵人, 中華民國政治人物. 早 served in 湖南都督, 後投入國民革命陣營, once served as 第二 served aschairman of the Nationalist government, 第一 served aspresident of the Executive Yuan. 與陳三立, 譚嗣同並稱"湖湘三公子", 書法造詣亦高, 被列為"民國四大書法家"之一. 1930-09-22 died. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 孫良誠 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 直隸天津靜海 in 1893; died in 1952; affiliation 西北軍; highest recorded post 馮玉祥十三太保之一／方面軍總指揮; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 孫良誠, 原名良臣, 字少雲, 直隸天津府靜海縣人, 馮玉祥西北軍將領, "十三太保"之一. 其父孫雲亭為清軍哨官, 孫良誠早年務農, in 1912投入馮玉祥 unit, 因才能出眾受馮賞識, 隨 unitparticipated inNorthern Expedition 及 warlord 混戰, gradually 升遷. 抗戰後期投靠汪精衛政權, became 該政權轄下方面軍將領, 戰後下場記載不詳, 1952-03去世. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 孫連仲 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 直隸雄縣 in 1893; died in 1990; affiliation 西北軍→中央軍系統; highest recorded post 中華民國陸軍二級上將; active period 北伐時期, 抗戰前期, 抗日後期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 孫連仲, 字仿魯, 直隸雄縣人, 中華民國 Army 二級 general, 馮玉祥"十三太保"之一. 國民軍時期 served as 第一 artillery 旅 brigade commander, afterwards 升 served ascavalry 第二師 division commander, his forces 軍紀嚴整, 於北方混戰中以善戰著稱. in 1926馮玉祥五原誓師後隨馮加入 Kuomintang, participated inNorthern Expedition, held the posts ofNational United Army 第十路 commander, National Revolutionary Army 第二集團軍第二方面軍總 commanded, 擊敗直軍, 奉軍. War of Resistance against Japanduring this period 為知名將領, participated in 多場對日 combat operations. 1990-08-14 died. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 鹿鐘麟 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 河北定州 in 1884; died in 1966; affiliation 西北軍; highest recorded post 國民革命軍高級將領（馮玉祥五虎將之一）; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 鹿鐘麟, 字瑞伯, 河北定州北鹿莊人, National Revolutionary Army 高級將領, 馮玉祥"五虎將"之一 (其餘四位為張之江, 宋哲元, 鄭金聲, 劉郁芬). in 1911 Xinhai Revolution 爆發後隨馮玉祥 took part in 灤州 uprising, uprising 失敗後受長官車震保護, afterwards 在馮玉祥 his forcesheld the posts of 連, 營, 旅級軍職, for a long period 隨馮玉祥 unit 發展. 1966-01-11 died. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 鄭大章 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 直隸靜海 in 1891; died in 1960; affiliation 西北軍; highest recorded post 西北軍高級騎兵將領; active period 北伐時期, 抗戰前期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 鄭大章, 號彩庭, 直隸靜海人, 馮玉祥西北軍高級 cavalry 將領, 畢業於保定 Armyofficer 學校 cavalry 科. for a long period 在西北軍 cavalryunitserved as 職, participated inNorthern Expedition 及對日 combat operations. in 1960 died. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 劉自珍 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in unknown; death year unknown; affiliation unknown affiliation; highest recorded post no confirmed highest post; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 劉自珍, the birth and death years are unknown, 天津.in 1937 served asNational Revolutionary Army 第二十九軍第三十七師第一百十一旅 brigade commander, 駐北平城內. 1948-11 served as 第三綏靖區幹訓團教育長, 同月8日 his forces 隨第三綏靖區前進 commanded 所直屬單位共兩千餘人, 在江蘇賈汪, 山東台兒庄一帶 leftNational Revolutionary Army 建制. another record states thatthe Republic of China government office database, 有一名劉自珍於 in 1923敘 Armyinfantrymajor, in 1936敘 Armymajor general; 官階與時序相接, whether this was the same person remains unconfirmed. 籍貫僅見於一處記載. Wiki-based biography draft. 徐永昌 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 山西崞縣 in 1887; died in 1959; affiliation 晉系; highest recorded post 國防部部長; active period 北伐時期. Source narrative (lexical draft): 徐永昌, 字次宸, 山西崞縣人, 中華民國 Army 一級 general, 晉系將領, for a long period 在閻錫山麾下 served as 職. 第二次世界大戰結束時, 代表中華民國前往日本 took part in 盟軍受降儀式, afterwardsbecame 中華民國國防部部長. 1959-07-12 died. [Proper names and unmatched historical terms remain in the source script; unreviewed wiki-derived draft.]

Wiki-based biography draft. 商震 is recorded as a historical military and political figure: born in 直隸大城（祖籍浙江紹興） in 1888; died in 1978; affiliation 晉系→國民革命軍; highest recorded post 第六戰區司令長官; active period 北伐時期, 抗戰前期.
